sections.error.actionPlace: {name} is the board's {kind} section, where the card actions (card_action) move cards: it cannot be made, moved elsewhere or deleted (there is one inside Goals; its name and description can be changed)
sections.error.cardGhostsGone: cardGhosts is not used. A card ghost is now a card placed in a section (kind ghost): create it with card_create, with where it goes and its name as target (e.g. Schemas/Ordering:Customer) and {"kind": "ghost", "target": "<path of the card it points to>"} as value; re-point it with card_update's target, rename it with name, and delete it with card_delete. To show a value or enum of the section's own on the diagram by itself, use standalone: true in that card's card_update value
sections.error.evacuationRename: {evacuation} is the app's set-aside section, so it cannot be renamed (it can be deleted once its contents are moved out and it is empty)
sections.error.hasGhosts: Section {path} has card ghosts in it ({ghosts}). Empty it before deleting it (delete them with card_delete, or move them to another section with section in card_update)
sections.error.hasSchemas: Section {path} has schemas in it ({count}). Empty it before deleting it (move them to another section, or delete them)
sections.error.hasSections: Section {path} has sections inside it ({inside}). Delete them first, or move them to another section
sections.error.hidesRoot: A section named "{name}" is directly under a root, so that name cannot be used
sections.error.intoItself: A section cannot be moved into itself
sections.error.lastSection: The last section cannot be deleted
sections.error.mainRootFixed: The root of main cannot be moved
sections.error.misfits: Section {path} holds {held}{more}, so it cannot become a {kind} section. Move them to another section first
sections.error.noType: A section's kind is set by the section it goes in (type can be given only when creating, and only for a project kind listed in sections of the containing section's kind definition). The sections directly under the root of main, a branch and the board are set by the project's project_tree (kind, name and order; projectTree in project_read), and other sections are made inside them. To change a kind, move the section with parent into a section that fits
sections.error.notAtTheTop: Sections cannot be created {tree}. The top-level sections ({here}) are set by the project's project_tree (creating, removing, reordering and renaming them is done with project_tree in project_update's value), and other sections are made inside them. A section's kind is set by the section it goes in
sections.error.notInside: Only {allowed} can be created inside a {kind} section ({wanted} cannot)
sections.error.nothingToChange: There is nothing to change (name / parent / description / position / exportTo / places / move / arrange / tidy)
sections.error.parentMissing: The parent section does not exist
sections.error.renameInBranch: {from} is a section directly under a root, and its name belongs to the project's tree (project_tree), so it is not renamed on a branch (it would take effect on main, every branch and the board). Call without branch, or rename it with renames in project_update's value
sections.error.reservedName: Names wrapped in underscores ({name}) are used by the app. Please use another name
sections.error.rootKind: The root of main and branches has no kind
sections.error.rootName: "{name}" is the name of a root, so it cannot be put directly under it
sections.error.rootOwnDelete: {name} is a {kind} section {tree}, so it cannot be deleted here (its name can be changed; take it out with project_tree: an empty one is removed, and one with contents has them moved to {evacuation})
sections.error.rootOwnKind: {name} is a {kind} section {tree}, so its kind cannot be changed
sections.error.rootOwnMove: {name} is a {kind} section {tree}, so it cannot be moved (its name and description can be changed; its order and removal are done in project_tree)
sections.error.settingsNotSections: Rules and the working directory are not sections but project settings (change them in Project Settings)
sections.error.topOrder: The order of the sections {tree} is set by the project's project_tree (reorder them with project_tree in project_update's value)
sections.error.unknownType: The project has no section kind "{written}". type accepts only the project's own kinds ({own}) (built-in kinds are set by the section they go in)
